critical_code_review_comments: Data Upload V2 module fully implemented with 6 upload types: daily_sales, store_inventory, warehouse_inventory, sku_master, store_master, warehouse_master

75-error validation system working: E003 (SKU not found), E011 (Store not found), E027 (negative qty), E041 (zero revenue), E043 (missing columns), E045 (empty file), E050 (duplicates), E070 (test data)
Template download generates Excel files with correct headers and dropdown validation from master data
Daily status endpoint returns upload status for 3 types (daily_sales, store_inventory, warehouse_inventory)
History endpoint returns grouped upload history with date labels (Today, Yesterday, formatted dates)
Frontend uses react-dropzone for drag-drop file upload with progress indicator
All data-testid attributes present for testing
seed_data_creation: Test uploads created during testing are recorded in upload_history collection. No master data seeded, so E003/E011 errors are expected for SKU/Store validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data Upload V2 module fully tested and working. Backend routes at /api/upload/v2/* with daily-sales, store-inventory, warehouse-inventory, sku-master, store-master, warehouse-master endpoints. Frontend page at /upload with DataUploadPage.jsx, DataUploadV2.jsx (dropzone), UploadHistory.jsx, UploadStatus.jsx components. 75-error validation system implemented in upload_service.py with error catalog in upload_errors.py. Template download uses openpyxl to generate Excel files. Demo tenant has no master data seeded, so SKU/Store validation errors (E003/E011) are expected - this is correct behavior per problem statement.

upload_endpoints.POST /api/upload/v2/daily-sales: Upload daily sales CSV with validation

status_endpoints.GET /api/upload/v2/daily-status: Returns today's upload status for 3 types
status_endpoints.GET /api/upload/v2/history: Returns grouped upload history with days filter

template_endpoint.GET /api/upload/v2/template/{upload_type: Downloads Excel template with headers and dropdown validation
